verdict.rationale: Vanta documents private integrations for systems it does not already integrate with, including on-premise and homegrown systems (vanta-docs-52). Its developer docs show pushing user accounts and custom resources from a homegrown app and turning them into pass/fail evidence via a Custom Test (vanta-docs-2), plus API endpoints to attach evidence files (vanta-docs-31) and a token-based quickstart (vanta-docs-1, vanta-docs-32). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom integrations work in practice, and a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404; published SDKs cover only the Auditor API).
